doc.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000

chapter: Current gigs and Goodman family stories
title: Sol's current weekly gigs
summary: Sol lists his Monday through Friday restaurant gigs, including Stony Hill Inn.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Play. Correct. I play on Monday nights at a place, an Italian restaurant called LaRavista. That’s on Restaurant Row which is West 46th Street between Eighth and Ninth Avenue. I’m there every Monday night. Then on Tuesday and Wednesday and Thursday night I play at a place called the Echo Italia Restaurant, that’s on Bleecker Street and Seventh © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

Avenue. I’m there from 8 to 11 on Tuesday and Wednesday and Thursday nights. Then on Friday night I play at a place in Hackensack, New Jersey. I went there for two weeks, I’m there going on three years, I’m there with a quintet at a place called the Stony Hill Inn. I’m going to give you the brochure of this restaurant. It was built in 1818, that’s 180 years ago. Wait until you see it. And I play there every Friday night from 7:30 to 11:30 for dinner, dining, dancing and listening. People love it. I play all these songs every Friday night. [Sol plays].
